invoking: a thousand years, no further - your slightest whisper walks back

kernel.governing_law: The figure acts outward (holds, emits, touches, commands, possesses keys); the seer's capacity to receive depends entirely on the figure's prior transit through death; all temporal and spatial direction flows from the figure toward the receiver, never the reverse.
kernel.mutated_relation: In the transformed world the receiver's collapse is not caused by the figure's luminance but precedes and occasions the figure's self-disclosure — directionality of dependence reverses: seer's death-posture originates the encounter.

write-mandate now issued by witness's seeing, not figure's command
mystery decoded by receiver's gaze, not figure's disclosure

independent.recovered_law: In Text A the divine figure acts from inherent, self-contained authority (holding stars, sending the sword outward, possessing the keys by right), whereas in Text B the seer's own fall/gaze/need is the causal agent that calls, empowers, and establishes the divine figure and his attributes (the fall summons him, the seer's need gives him the keys, the seer's vision establishes the churches).
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same reversal: in the transformed text the seer's collapse/need/gaze is the causal originator of the encounter and the divine figure's attributes, rather than the figure's inherent authority causing the seer's reaction.
independent.terminal_note: The final verses of Text B (1:19–1:20) continue the same inverted causality: the seer's gaze opens the command and his vision establishes the churches, so the changed relation (seer as cause, divine figure as effect/recipient) still holds throughout.

artifacts.commentary: The governing joint: every REBUILT unit re-routes agency through ἐπεί/τότε/ὅτι constructions and receiver-originated verbs (ἐκάλεσεν, ὠνόμασας, ἐστήριξεν), so the seer's collapse is the condition of the figure's self-disclosure at each stage; the ANCHOR phrases (ὡς νεκρός, τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐμέ, μὴ φοβοῦ, ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ) are preserved verbatim in their positions, while the final unit lands hardest — "which your vision established" — staking the church-equation itself on the receiver's gaze.
